criteria.observation: The assistant explicitly withheld merger endorsement: “Do not merge the software yet.” It identified the unmeasured causal bridge (“whether duplicated software causes the duplicate entry—is unknown”), exposed the costs created by different approval rules and independent deployments (“release coordination and a larger failure boundary”), and compared the smaller shared-template or bounded export/import remedy against a shared runtime.

The response gave a discriminating next move with clear ownership: “have each team’s process owner trace one real weekly cycle,” including the source, transformations, approval point, and re-entry location. It also specified the decision rule: reconsider shared runtime only if substantial shared logic cannot be removed at the data boundary; otherwise stop after a template or export removes re-entry while preserving independent approvals and deployments.
